rationale: The non-voter transfer account carries one unexplained outcome: receipt a319426e86514f45b2053a7b3bd8050b recorded the explicit transfer returning 'leadership transfer in progress' on every one of five attempts, while the later flag probe with the transfer flag clear returned no error at all. That leaves the account unable to say whether the in-progress surface is a stable property of this harness or a timing accident, and the limitation says so. Repeating the exact fixed experiment that produced the in-progress errors, from its retained inputs and with no changes, decides between those readings on a recorded receipt: a repeat that again reports in-progress errors would make that surface reproducible in the harness, and one that returns no error would show it depends on the run.
